      "rationale": "Eliminates the need for waitNext to repeatedly lock cs_main and construct full block templates on every tick just to check mempool fee inflow. As stated in the description, assembling full block templates solely to compare fee revenue creates unnecessary lock contention and latency in the mining loop."
